SELECT server_id serverId, server_name serverName, server_desc serverDesc, server_ip serverIp, server_port serverPort, server_type serverType, server_status serverStatus, organ_id organId, user_id userId, cpu_cores cpuCores, memory_gb memoryGb, storage_gb storageGb, config, last_heartbeat lastHeartbeat, server_url serverUrl, is_del isDel, create_date createDate, update_date updateDate FROM server WHERE server_id = #{serverId} AND is_del = 0

SELECT agent_id agentId, agent_name agentName, agent_type agentType, agent_desc agentDesc, endpoint, status, organ_id organId, user_id userId, is_del isDel, create_date createDate, update_date updateDate FROM agent WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND is_del = 0

SELECT sr.id, sr.server_id serverId, sr.resource_id resourceId, sr.allocation_status allocationStatus, sr.uri uri, sr.create_date createDate, dr.resource_name resourceName, dr.resource_desc resourceDesc FROM server_resource sr LEFT JOIN data_resource dr ON sr.resource_id = dr.resource_id AND dr.is_del = 0 WHERE sr.server_id = #{serverId} AND sr.is_del = 0 ORDER BY sr.id DESC

SELECT sm.id, sm.server_id serverId, sm.model_id modelId, sm.model_version modelVersion, sm.deployment_status deploymentStatus, sm.uri uri, sm.create_date createDate, dm.model_name modelName FROM server_model sm LEFT JOIN data_model dm ON sm.model_id = dm.model_id AND dm.is_del = 0 WHERE sm.server_id = #{serverId} AND sm.is_del = 0 ORDER BY sm.id DESC

SELECT sa.id, sa.server_id serverId, sa.artifact_id artifactId, sa.artifact_status artifactStatus, sa.uri uri, sa.create_date createDate FROM server_artifact sa WHERE sa.server_id = #{serverId} AND sa.is_del = 0 ORDER BY sa.id DESC

SELECT sn.id, sn.server_id serverId, sn.node_id nodeId, sn.access_type accessType, sn.is_primary isPrimary, sn.uri uri, sn.create_date createDate, ncp.organ_name nodeName, ncp.cooperation_type cooperationType FROM server_node sn LEFT JOIN node_cooperation_party ncp ON sn.node_id = ncp.id AND ncp.is_del = 0 WHERE sn.server_id = #{serverId} AND sn.is_del = 0 ORDER BY sn.id DESC

SELECT sag.id, sag.server_id serverId, sag.agent_id agentId, sag.run_status runStatus, sag.uri uri, sag.create_date createDate, ag.agent_name agentName, ag.agent_type agentType FROM server_agent sag LEFT JOIN agent ag ON sag.agent_id = ag.agent_id AND ag.is_del = 0 WHERE sag.server_id = #{serverId} AND sag.is_del = 0 ORDER BY sag.id DESC
